licenses.text:
Синодальный перевод, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/russyn/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/russyn/copyright.htm):
> Synodal Translation of the Holy Bible in Russian
> Public Domain
> Language: русский (Russian)
> 2022-11-25

What was found:
Text: the Russian Synodal Bible (first complete edition 1876); eBible's text uses spelling from after 1917.

Why it stays out: missing fact: which edition eBible's modern-spelling text reproduces (the 1876 Synodal text, or the 1956 or later editions edited by A. A. Osipov), and the death years of the named translators.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=russyn), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/russyn/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_Synodal_Bible; https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Синодальный_перевод.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)
